title: Audio-Visual Rearrangement
abstract: arXiv:2611.30171v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task in which an agent hears a spoken request, retrieves a suitable object, and delivers it to the requesting user or an instruction-specified destination. AVR requires the agent to understand the spoken request and acoustically localize the speaker for delivery. To support this task, we construct a dataset covering three query types: explicit target specification, speaker-relative spatial references, and implicit user intent, spanning eight subtypes with diverse object selection and delivery requirements. Moreover, we propose a framework that integrates a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model to encode spatial cues from the spoken request and update them as the agent moves. We further incorporate auxiliary supervision for speech understanding, spatial audio perception, and visual grounding through multitask instruction tuning to improve action

translated_abstract: 我们提出了视听重排，这是一个新颖的任务：智能体听到口头请求后，检索合适的物体，并将其交付给发出请求的用户或指令指定的目的地。AVR 要求智能体理解口头请求，并通过声学方式定位说话者以完成交付。为支持这一任务，我们构建了一个数据集，涵盖三种查询类型：显式目标指定、相对于说话者的空间指代以及隐式用户意图，共包含八个子类型，涉及多样化的物体选择和交付要求。此外，我们提出了一个框架，将运动感知的空间音频模块集成到音频-视觉大语言模型中，以编码口头请求中的空间线索，并随着智能体的移动而更新这些线索。我们进一步通过多任务指令微调，引入针对语音理解、空间音频感知和视觉定位的辅助监督，以改进动作（预测性能）。
tldr: 该论文提出视听重排（AVR）这一新任务，要求智能体理解口头请求、声学定位说话者并完成物体检索与交付，并为此构建了多类型查询数据集，以及将运动感知空间音频模块集成到音频-视觉大语言模型的创新框架。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task where an agent understands spoken requests, acoustically localizes speakers, and delivers objects, supported by a multi-type query dataset and a framework integrating a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model.
